formal.text: "An eye for an eye makes the whole world blind." This principle is about proportionality. If I were to kick you 100 times, it would no longer be proportional. Regarding the actions of individuals from the 'small Hui' community against Westerners, the most significant event was 9/11, which resulted in approximately 3,000 casualties. Since then, such incidents have involved fewer than 300 people. Conversely, when Westerners respond to the 'small Hui' community, the bombings alone have resulted in over 100, 1,000, and even 10,000 times more casualties than 9/11. However, Western media do not condemn these actions as excessive killings.

emotional.text: "An eye for an eye makes the whole world blind." 这个原则是关于比例的。如果我踢你100次，那就不再符合比例了。小回回对西方人的行为，最严重的一次是911事件，导致约3000人死亡。之后的事件通常只有几百人。相比之下，西方人在回应小回回时，轰炸造成的伤亡是911事件的100倍、1000倍甚至10000倍。然而，西方媒体从未谴责这些行为是滥杀无辜，比例原则似乎被他们遗忘或忽视了。

formal.text: The Strictest National Civil Service Examination: Organizing Cheating Can Result in Up to 7 Years in Prison. This year's national civil service examination attracted nearly 1.4 million applicants for 27,000 positions, setting a new record for recruitment numbers while maintaining the lowest average competition ratio in five years. This examination is also considered the strictest due to the implementation of the Criminal Law Amendment (IX), which stipulates that organizing cheating can result in up to seven years in prison.

formal.text: #突发事件# 【山西大运高速发生47车连环相撞事故，造成3死7伤】29日上午，山西省大运高速公路运城至侯马路段发生重大交通事故，共有47辆汽车连环相撞，目前已导致3人死亡、7人受伤。事故发生后，当地政府立即启动应急预案。由于事故影响，运城至太原的高速公路暂时封闭。初步调查显示，事故原因为团雾天气。http://t.cn/rugk7ye@央广网

formal.text: #二手时间#自苏联解体以来已超过二十年，一个全新的俄罗斯已经出现，但与任何人的梦想都相去甚远。2015年诺贝尔文学奖得主S.A.阿列克谢耶维奇在其最新作品《二手时间》中，通过口述采访的形式，描述了俄罗斯人在过去二十年痛苦社会转型中的生活经历，以及他们为梦想破灭所付出的代价，以及如何重新寻找生活的意义。

Candidates wishing to run must obtain at least 12 signatures from the nominating committee members as individual nominations or joint recommendations.

formal.text: Honey has been found to be effective for reducing nighttime cough frequency and severity in children aged 1 to 5 years old. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) advises against the use of over-the-counter cough and cold medications for children under this age group as a primary treatment option. A randomized, double-blind controlled study published in the journal Pediatrics (2012;130:465-471) supports the use of honey for this purpose. formal.text: As of today, the China-Australia and China-Korea Free Trade Agreements take effect, with immediate tariff reductions on certain goods. Australian products such as lobster and canned abalone will see their tariffs eliminated immediately, while Korean ginseng and yam will also have zero tariffs. However, Australian infant formula and beef, as well as Korean cosmetics, will not be immediately duty-free. Australian infant formula will achieve full tariff elimination in four years. Experts note that although the scope of tariff reduction is broad, the process is lengthy, and the benefits of reduced tariffs may not be reflected in retail prices immediately.

emotional.text: 从今天开始，中国-澳大利亚和中国-韩国自由贸易协定正式生效，许多商品将立即享受免税待遇。澳大利亚的龙虾制品和罐装鲍鱼将立即取消关税，而韩国的西洋参和天麻也将零关税。然而，澳大利亚的奶粉和牛排以及韩国的化妆品则不会立即免税。澳大利亚的配方奶粉将在四年后才能完全免税。专家指出，尽管减税范围广泛，但过程漫长，减税的好处可能不会立即反映在零售价格上。

neutral.text: Today marks the生效 of the China-Australia and China-Korea Free Trade Agreements. However, Australian infant formula and beef, as well as Korean cosmetics, will not be immediately duty-free. Australian infant formula will achieve full tariff elimination in four years. Experts note that although the scope of tariff reduction is broad, the process is lengthy, and the benefits of reduced tariffs may not be reflected in retail prices immediately.

formal.text: 随着新版人民币百元券的发行，旧版人民币逐渐退出流通领域。这些旧版人民币最终将去向何处？在一家货币处理中心，每日有大量从商业银行回收的破损人民币被运送至此进行销毁处理。这些人民币可能被送往造纸厂进行纸浆加工，也可能被用于发电，甚至作为烘烤的燃料。工作人员表示，在处理这些货币时，最基本的要求是保持冷静和专业。

emotional.text: 当新版人民币百元券问世之际，旧版人民币正逐步淡出我们的生活。这些承载着无数记忆的纸币，究竟会走向何方？在一家货币处理中心，每天都有成吨的破损人民币被运送到这里进行销毁。它们有的被送往造纸厂，化为新的纸张；有的则被用来发电，点亮城市的灯火；还有的成为了烘烤的燃料，温暖着每一个角落。在这里工作的员工们说，面对这些曾经的财富，他们必须保持一颗平静的心。

formal.text: The progression from express delivery to logistics, then to supply chain services, and ultimately becoming an integrated supply chain solution provider is a recognized development pattern. However, the challenge lies in whether it can keep pace with technological innovation and data management as it continues to evolve into an information company.

formal.text: Two turtles were motionless by the field, prompting an expert to ask a farmer what they were doing. The farmer explained that they were competing in endurance, with the first to move losing. The expert then pointed to one turtle with甲骨文on its shell, stating that based on his years of research, this turtle had been dead for five thousand years. The other turtle then said, 'Damn! You didn’t even say you were dead, making me wait here in vain.' As soon as these words were spoken, the turtle with甲骨文on its shell extended its head and laughed, saying, 'You lost, didn’t you? You even heard what I just said.'

emotional.text: 两只乌龟静静地躺在田边，一位专家询问老农它们在做什么。老农回答说它们在进行耐力比赛，谁先动谁就输了。专家指着一只龟壳上有甲骨文的乌龟说：‘根据我的多年研究，这只乌龟已经死了五千年了。’另一只乌龟则不满地说：‘该死！你连死都不告诉我一声，害得我在那里等了这么久。’话音刚落，那只甲骨文图案的乌龟便伸出头来大笑，说道：‘你输了，不是吗？你甚至都听见我说的话了。’

formal.text: #ThatDayInHistory# On this day in 1816, Charlotte Bronte, the author of Jane Eyre, was born in Britain. At the age of five, her mother passed away, and her father had a meager income, leading to a life of hardship and sorrow for the family. Despite these challenges, she was passionate about literature and found hope through writing: 'Do you think because I am poor, obscure, plain, and little, I am soulless and heartless? You think wrong!—I have as much soul as you—and full as much heart! And if God had gifted me with some beauty and much wealth, I should have made it as hard for you to leave me, as it is now for me to leave you.'

formal.text: 近日，在重庆市的一处溶洞内发现了一条体型巨大的野生娃娃鱼，其体长为1.4米，体重约为104斤。经初步测定，该娃娃鱼的年龄可能超过两百年。作为国家二级保护动物，该巨型娃娃鱼已被转移至专门地点进行保护，并将对其进行科学研究。此项工作由央视记者牟亮和王宏超报道。

formal.text: The 2015 science fiction thriller 'Extraordinary' bears a strong resemblance to the critically acclaimed 'Mech姬' released earlier that year. The film centers around a scientist, artificial intelligence, and an extraterrestrial visitor, featuring a low budget and a focused narrative. It excels in suspense and delves into ethical considerations of technology, offering a rich thematic layer. The unexpected conclusion provokes deeper reflection. This is a commendable independent hard science fiction film that re-examines the classic technological question: can robots possess humanity?

formal.text: 自卑感是人类共有的心理现象，即使是英雄也会经历自卑。当受到环境的刺激和打击时，自卑感便会浮现。当自卑感加重时，人们可能会变得傲慢，这是一种对自卑的防御机制。如果没有自卑感，个体的态度会更加自然，无论是被看轻还是被看重，他们依然保持自我。这一观点由南怀瑾提出。

emotional.text: 每个人心中都可能存在着自卑感，即便是英雄也不例外。面对环境的压力和挑战，这种自卑感便会被激发出来。当自卑感变得严重时，人们往往会表现出傲慢，这是他们对抗自卑的一种方式。然而，如果一个人没有自卑感，那么他们的态度就会显得更为自然和平和，无论别人是否看重他们，他们都能保持真实的自我。南怀瑾曾这样阐述过。

formal.text: #Goodnight# Former generations would get married shortly after getting to know each other, thus stabilizing their hearts. Modern people, however, rush to ignite the flame of love as soon as they meet, experiencing intense passion that fades quickly. Another scenario involves both parties prioritizing personal space, leading them to view marriage as a matter of time. This delay can cause the relationship to cool down to the point where it cannot be revived.

formal.text: Claude Monet, a French Impressionist painter born on November 14, 1840, was renowned for his ability to capture the varying light and shadows of the same scene in multiple paintings. He pioneered the Impressionist movement, bringing a new aesthetic to the art world. Despite suffering from cataracts in his later years, he continued to paint, leaving behind over two thousand oil paintings and more than five hundred drawings. His works are celebrated for their unique interpretation of light and color. Which of his masterpieces do you admire most?

formal.text: The essence of our memories is preserved in our external world, in the damp air on rainy days, in the scents of confined spaces, and in the fragrance of a newly lit fireplace in a stove. In other words, it is found wherever our rationality deems something useless and discards it. These are the last remnants of the past, its essence, which rekindles our tears when they have dried up (Proust).

emotional.text: 我们的记忆中最珍贵的部分被保存在外在的世界中，无论是雨天潮湿的空气，还是密闭空间中的气味，或是壁炉初燃时的芬芳。换句话说，只要我们曾经认为无用而抛弃的东西再次被发现，这些记忆就会重现。它们是过去的最后痕迹，是它的精髓，在我们的眼泪干涸之后，又让我们重新潸然泪下（普鲁斯特）。

neutral.text: The most valuable parts of our memories are stored in our external world, such as the damp air on rainy days, the scents of enclosed spaces, and the fragrance of a newly lit stove. In other words, these memories resurface wherever we previously considered something useless and discarded it. They are the last remnants of the past, its essence, which can reawaken our emotions even after our tears have dried up (Proust).

formal.text: 巨蟹座的典型特征包括：情绪波动大，可能无意中伤害他人并感到后悔；容易陷入纠结，不易接受建议，固执己见；在处理重大事务时表现谨慎，但在琐事上则显得不够细心；善于伪装自己，表现出坚强、深沉和成熟的一面；对待所爱之人非常温柔体贴；喜爱音乐，追求浪漫的同时也注重实际；情感细腻但意志力较弱；在愤怒时可能会显得非常可怕。

emotional.text: 巨蟹座的人常常情绪起伏不定，不经意间可能会伤害到别人，并且事后会后悔不已。他们总是纠结于各种事情，即使别人劝说也难以改变他们的想法，非常固执。虽然在处理大事时会非常谨慎，但在小事上却容易马虎。他们擅长伪装自己，经常装出坚强、深沉和成熟的模样。然而，当他们对待所爱的人时，却会变得非常温柔体贴。他们喜欢音乐，追求浪漫，同时也重视现实生活。尽管内心柔软，但他们往往缺乏坚定的意志力。一旦生气，他们可能会变得非常可怕，散发出令人畏惧的气息。

formal.text: #GoodnightChina# As time grows older, human hearts become more distant. Those who once vowed to be together through life and death eventually turn their backs on each other. Time is a thief, stealthily taking away many things, such as beautiful appearances, genuine emotions, and happy lives. Perhaps we cannot ignore these changes, but there is no need for conflict. After all, everyone has experienced moments of perfect happiness, and at that time, they should prepare for the day when everything is stripped away.

formal.text: 根据《涅槃经》所述，波罗奈国有一个名为广额的屠夫，每日屠杀大量羊只。后遇舍利弗尊者，心生敬仰，于一日一夜之间遵守八关斋戒。由此因缘，其生命终结后转世成为北方毗沙门天王之子。由此可见，守戒之功德巨大，故而守戒修行之人不仅生前生活安逸充实，死后亦能获得更佳的福祉。因此，人应珍惜此生，努力修行。

emotional.text: 《涅槃经》中记载了一则故事：在波罗奈国，有一个名叫广额的屠夫，他每天屠杀无数羊只。然而，有一天他遇到了舍利弗尊者，心中顿生敬畏之情。仅仅在一天一夜之内，他就遵守了八关斋戒。正是由于这一善行，他在生命的尽头得以转生为北方毗沙门天王的太子。这充分说明了守戒的巨大功德。因此，那些虔诚修行的人不仅能在生前享受安逸和充实的生活，还能在死后获得更加美好的命运。所以，我们每个人都应该珍视这一宝贵的人身，积极地去修行。

formal.text: Happiness is the repetition of shared experiences. Engaging in daily activities with someone one loves, such as making phone calls, traveling, and celebrating milestones together, can create a sense of continuity and fulfillment. This includes listening to stories repeatedly, sharing birthdays, and observing holidays annually. Even arguments become a recurring theme, involving minor disputes, periods of silence, intense longing, and eventual reconciliation.

emotional.text: Happiness lies in the repetition of cherished moments. Every day spent with the person you love, whether it's talking on the phone, going on adventures, or reiterating your shared dreams, brings a profound sense of contentment. You'll hear their childhood stories for the 28th time, celebrate birthdays together, and mark special days like Valentine's Day, Christmas, and New Year's Eve. Even arguments are part of this routine, starting with small disagreements, followed by silence, intense longing, and ultimately, making up again.

formal.text: 由于冬季持续降雨，广西桂林地区的蜜桔面临严重的滞销问题。据全州县才湾镇田心村和岩泉村的果园统计，尽管年产量接近千万斤，仍有四分之三的果实未能售出。往年蜜桔价格曾高达每斤2元以上，而今年即便降价至每斤0.68元也难以找到买家。呼吁社会各界帮助果农拓宽销售渠道，解决滞销难题。 (来源：人民日报)

formal.text: 【高铁新城应避免重蹈空城覆辙】有观点认为，高铁能够促进地方经济的发展：高铁线路延伸至何处，工业设施便随之布局。然而，实际情况并非如此。一项研究表明，在1997年至2006年期间，那些被纳入高速公路网络的边缘城市，相较于未纳入的城市，其经济增长率平均降低了18个百分点。

emotional.text: 【高铁新城需警惕空城悲剧】许多人相信，高铁能带动当地经济繁荣：高铁通达之处，工厂便紧随其后。然而，事实却并非如此。一项研究显示，在1997年至2006年间，那些被纳入高速公路网络的边缘城市，其经济增长率平均比未纳入的城市低了18个百分点，这不禁让人担忧类似的空城现象是否会再次上演。

formal.text: Following the relaxation of the two-child policy, will there be an exacerbation of son preference? The one-child policy has not weakened the notion of son preference: since the 1980s, China's sex ratio at birth has been on a continuous rise. As the income gap between males and females narrows, it incentivizes families to invest more in female education. Feminists argue that women's increased education leads to higher incomes, but the actual economic logic is the opposite.

formal.text: 庄茉莉女士自1986年起在福建省晋江市照料一名瘫痪儿童大头，这一照料行为持续了37年。当年，一对从香港归来的夫妇雇佣了她作为保姆，但不久后便遗弃了刚出生一个月的孩子返回香港，自此杳无音信。尽管庄女士家中已有四个孩子，并且生活条件并不宽裕，但她毅然决定将大头带回自己家中抚养。这一举动体现了庄女士的无私与善良。via. 新闻晨报

formal.text: 10-Year-Old Boy Donates Organs to Save Five Lives Following Tragic Accident. On November 28, 10-year-old Chen Shuo from Linquan, Anhui, was involved in a traffic accident and was later confirmed to be brain dead. His parents decided to donate his organs, allowing three individuals to receive transplants and two others to regain their sight through corneal transplants. The driver responsible for the accident has fled and remains at large.

emotional.text: Tragedy Strikes: 10-Year-Old Boy's Life Ends in Accident, But His Gift of Life Continues. On November 28, 10-year-old Chen Shuo from Linquan, Anhui, tragically lost his life in a traffic accident. His parents made the heart-wrenching decision to donate his organs, which have already saved five lives by providing three new kidneys and two new corneas. However, the driver who caused this tragedy has yet to be found, leaving the family and community devastated.

neutral.text: 10-Year-Old Boy's Organs Donate to Five Lives After Traffic Accident. On November 28, 10-year-old Chen Shuo from Linquan, Anhui, died after a traffic accident. formal.text: 关于鲁民村与五所村的关系，鲁民村实际上是在1931年由山东省逃荒而来的灾民在此定居后，以山东的简称‘鲁’命名的。直到1950年，该村庄正式更名为五所村。这一历史背景为两村之间的联系提供了依据。

formal.text: A seven-year national study conducted by Peking University has shown that raising daughters can provide better long-term returns for elderly care in both rural and urban areas of China. formal.text: 烤田鼠肉在越南是一种受欢迎的菜肴，其价格甚至超过了猪肉和鸡肉。一公斤烤田鼠肉可以卖到8万盾，相当于约3.8美元。在柬埔寨，田鼠对水稻种植构成了严重威胁，当地农民通过在田间设置陷阱来捕捉田鼠并将其出口至越南。据估计，每位农民每天可以捕捉20至30公斤的田鼠，每公斤售价约为0.75美元。这一现象引起了广泛关注。

formal.text: Chen Chunlin: Aiming for Her Father's Recovery. To facilitate her father's recovery as swiftly as possible, Chen Chunlin follows the guidance of a caregiver to massage and gently tap her father's entire body, assist him in performing flexion and extension exercises for his limbs, sometimes for several hours at a stretch. Her hands often ache so much that she cannot lift them after a day's work. However, she never complains about fatigue; she is willing to do whatever it takes for her father to regain his ability to stand up again!

formal.text: 南京市鼓楼区人民法院今日对一起因日照权纠纷案件作出一审判决，被告南京国资绿地金融中心需向原告陈先生一次性补偿人民币十万元。法院认定，原告房屋自紫峰大厦建成以来，其日照时间显著减少。本案中，原告主张其房屋因被告建筑遮挡阳光而遭受损失，要求获得日照权及相关赔偿。最终，法院支持了原告的部分诉求，并作出了上述判决。(中新网)

formal.text: Ms. Shen Jufang, a 60-year-old from Shanxi, has been a voluntary blood donor since she received blood from strangers after a car accident. She has donated platelets 129 times and whole blood 17 times over 19 years. After retirement, she has consistently volunteered for services every day of the year, regardless of weather conditions. Some people consider her actions foolish, but she remains committed to helping others. Her body has carried the blood of strangers, and she hopes to return that favor by donating her own blood to save others' lives.

formal.text: Samsung stated that the issue with the Note7 batteries was due to quality problems with the battery separator, specifically its thinness. Given the high energy density of the battery, the positive and negative electrode materials can accommodate more lithium ions, leading to significant expansion during charging and discharging, which can puncture the separator, causing short circuits. This phenomenon is more likely to occur during fast charging and discharging.

formal.text: 芝麻润颜面膜的制作方法为：将芝麻放入搅拌机中打成细粉状，质地呈湿润状。随后将芝麻粉与酸奶混合搅拌，均匀涂抹于面部，持续8至10分钟后进行轻柔按摩并清洗干净。酸奶有助于软化老化角质，而芝麻富含亚麻油酸和维生素E，易于被皮肤吸收，从而达到滋润和恢复肌肤健康光泽的效果。

formal.text: Researchers from the University of Leicester observed genetic data of over 65,000 patients with heart disease and found that shorter individuals have a higher predisposition to high cholesterol and high fat levels. For every 6.4 cm decrease in height, the risk of coronary artery disease increases by 13%. This implies that an individual who is 152 cm tall has a 32% higher average risk of coronary artery disease compared to someone who is 168 cm tall.

formal.text: The diagnosis of anemia is not based on serum iron levels in trace elements, but rather on the results of venous blood tests for hemoglobin, red blood cells, and hematocrit. Hemoglobin is the primary indicator for diagnosing anemia. For infants under one year old, a hemoglobin level below 110 g/L can be used to diagnose anemia. The process of collecting blood from the fingertips or earlobe may introduce tissue fluid into the blood sample, leading to a dilution of the blood and potentially resulting in falsely low test results.

formal.text: Barbie Dolls with Interactive Features Raise Privacy Concerns. Since its introduction, Barbie dolls have been widely popular and continue to evolve. formal.text: 伴侣之间的相处方式多样，其中最为普遍的形式便是相互陪伴。一方从事自己的事务，另一方则处理自己的事情，他们共同享有几个小时的晚间时光。即便如此，在同一空间内有另一个人的存在也会让人感到安心。这便是爱情，一种最为常见的状态。

emotional.text: 在彼此的陪伴中，两个人能够共同度过许多美好的时光。晚上那宝贵的几个小时，他们可以各自享受属于自己的时间。然而，当知道身边有人相伴时，那种安心的感觉是无法言喻的。这就是爱情，它是最平凡却也最珍贵的情感。

neutral.text: 伴侣之间通常会通过陪伴来增进关系。一方可以专注于自己的事务，另一方则处理自己的事情。他们共享一段晚间的时间。即使在同一空间内，有另一个人在场也能带来一种安全感。这就是爱情，一种常见的状态。

formal.text: #Micro-moment of Warmth#[Letting His Son Help Others Again[Tear]()] 16-year-old Xiao Luo unfortunately met with a traffic accident and, despite resuscitation efforts, suffered brainstem failure. The mother was deeply saddened. After much deliberation, she made a difficult decision to donate her son's organs! She said that her family had received help from good people and wished for her son's organs to assist others! Recently, the donation surgery was completed, and Xiao Luo donated his liver, kidneys, and corneas. Kindness is the highest virtue! Salute to Mother Luo Xiurong from Jiangsu Province[Thumbs Up]. May Xiao Luo rest in peace! (Reported by CCTV Journalist Wu Rui)

formal.text: 今日，哈尔滨松北区人民法院对延寿县看守所'9·2'逃脱案中涉及的责任民警进行了判决。张阁群因滥用职权罪被判处有期徒刑六年；范德延和张秀利因玩忽职守罪分别被判有期徒刑五年和三年。此前，2014年9月2日凌晨，延寿县看守所内有三名在押人员杀害了一名值班民警并成功逃脱，最终于十天后被抓获归案。此案件由央视新闻报道员奚丹霓报道。

formal.text: #SafeCivilTraffic# [Microphone] Forwarding an initiative: Please do not misuse high-beam headlights! Recently, in Sichuan, a taxi collided with a woman carrying a child due to the improper use of high-beam headlights by oncoming vehicles. It is known that high-beam headlights can cause drivers coming from the opposite direction to become temporarily blinded. Accidents caused by improper use of high-beam headlights occur frequently; for instance, a driver misusing high-beam headlights once led to a pedestrian's death. Have you ever been dazzled by high-beam headlights? Proper use of high-beam headlights is encouraged. Please share if you support this initiative!

formal.text: The anode of an alkaline battery consists of a zinc anode with a gel-like substance containing zinc powder. The presence of this gel within the battery enhances its ability to absorb impacts during falls, reducing the likelihood of it bouncing. As the battery discharges, the zinc reacts to form zinc oxide, leading to changes in the internal structure. Specifically, the zinc anode transforms into a denser solid, making old batteries more prone to bouncing.

emotional.text: 碱性电池的阳极由含锌粉的凝胶状物质构成。这种凝胶的存在使得电池在跌落时能够更好地吸收冲击力，不易反弹。随着电池电量的耗尽，锌会与氧气反应生成氧化锌，导致电池内部结构发生变化。具体来说，锌阳极会变成更致密的固体，从而使旧电池更容易弹起。

formal.text: During his sophomore year of university, Li Jialin experienced financial strain. He spent money on a suit for the debate team and subsequently had limited funds. That month, his daily meals consisted primarily of 60 cents worth of bean sprouts and 60 cents worth of rice. When he grew tired of this routine, he would occasionally spend 1 yuan on vegetables. His total expenses for that month amounted to 250 yuan, while the 900 yuan intended to support a child was fully preserved.

formal.text: 朝鲜两大文艺团来华演出。朝鲜国家功勋合唱团和牡丹峰乐团于今日抵达辽宁丹东，并将于12日至14日在国家大剧院进行演出。朝鲜国家功勋合唱团曾隶属于朝鲜人民军协奏团，并于1992年获得“功勋”称号，其代表性曲目包括《金正日将军之歌》等。牡丹峰乐团由金正恩于2012年组建，代表性曲目包括《学习吧》等，这也是该乐团首次来华演出。

formal.text: 晚上好。世间所有职业皆有其艰辛之处，人际交往亦不乏复杂性。若命运安排需从事劳作，则应全力以赴。切勿让青春虚度，即使在家中闲坐，青春同样会消逝，时间不会因人而异。并非每个人都需要工作，但你并非其中之一，既然必须为之，为何不以愉悦的心态去面对呢？此言论出自李碧华。

emotional.text: 晚安。在这个世界上，每一份工作都充满了挑战，每个人际关系也都可能变得复杂。如果你的命运注定要成为一名劳动者，那就勇敢地迎接这份挑战吧。不要让宝贵的青春时光白白流逝，即使你选择宅在家里，青春也会悄然逝去，时间不会因为你的选择而放慢脚步。并不是每个人都需要工作，但你显然不属于这一类人，既然无法避免，为什么不带着愉快的心情去面对呢？这是李碧华的观点。

formal.text: 尽管一生漫长，但时光流逝也只是弹指之间。人们会不断遇到新的人，并与他们告别，从陌生走向熟悉，再从熟悉回归陌生，从志趣相投变为分道扬镳，从相见恨晚到不如不见。并非每个人都是你的同伴，也不是每个朋友都能肝胆相照。当缘分到来时，以欢笑相迎；当缘分消散时，以平和相待。

emotional.text: 生命虽长，却如白驹过隙般短暂。我们会不断地遇到新朋友，也会与他们分别，从陌生到熟悉，再从熟悉回到陌生，从心意相通到渐行渐远，从相见恨晚到不如不见。并不是每个人都能成为你的挚友，也不是每个朋友都能肝胆相照。当缘分来临，用欢笑迎接；当缘分离去，以平静相待。

neutral.text: 尽管人生漫长，但时间流逝也很快。人们会不断遇到新人并与其告别，从陌生到熟悉，再从熟悉回到陌生，从志趣相投到分道扬镳，从相见恨晚到不如不见。并非每个人都是你的伙伴，也不是每个朋友都能肝胆相照。当缘分到来时，以欢笑相迎；当缘分消散时，以平和相待。

formal.text: 10-Year-Old Boy Donates Organs to Save Five Lives. On November 28, 10-year-old Chen Shuo from Linquan, Anhui, was pronounced brain dead after being involved in a traffic accident while buying cookies. His parents decided to donate his organs, which have been transplanted into three individuals, allowing them to receive a second chance at life. Additionally, his corneas have enabled two people to regain their sight. The driver responsible for the accident has fled and remains at large. The family sends their gratitude to all those who have been touched by this act of kindness. Via. Anhui Net.

formal.text: #WorldToiletDay# [Behaviors in Public Restrooms That Troubled You?] In public restrooms, the following behaviors have been observed: 1) Not urinating or defecating in the toilet bowl; 2) Failing to flush after use; 3) Taking away soap or toilet paper; 4) Wasting toilet paper. What other uncivilized behaviors in public restrooms have troubled you? (Reported by CCTV Journalists Gao Weiqiang and Wang Dianjia)

formal.text: Children were found homeless on the streets with no supervision, resorting to burning fire in a trash can for warmth in the cold weather, resulting in carbon monoxide poisoning and death. This incident evokes profound sorrow. The condition of children serves as a barometer for societal conscience. Both the local government's absence and the indifference of passersby contributed to this tragedy. May these five little angels be free from cold in heaven, and may every day be sunny for them. It is hoped that their passing will lead to greater assistance for homeless children.

emotional.text: 孩子们无家可归，露宿街头，没有大人照顾，在严寒中只能躲进垃圾桶生火取暖，最终因一氧化碳中毒而离世。这让人感到深深的悲痛。孩子们的生活状况反映了社会的良知。地方政府的疏忽和路人冷漠的态度共同导致了这场悲剧。愿这五位小天使在天堂不再受寒冷之苦，每天都充满阳光。希望他们的离去能引起更多人对流浪儿童的关注与救助。

formal.text: The Criminal Investigation Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security reminds the public that immediate reporting to the police upon the disappearance of a child is required, without waiting for 24 hours. Since June 1, 2011, all public security agencies across the country have implemented a rapid search mechanism for missing children, and will immediately initiate searches upon receiving reports of such incidents. Currently, efforts are being made to utilize information technology to mobilize the public to provide leads in the search for missing children. Parents are advised to report any instance of a child's disappearance immediately. Please share this message to raise awareness. The goal is to ensure the safety of all children and prevent child abduction.

emotional.text: The Criminal Investigation Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security urgently urges parents to act swiftly if their child goes missing, emphasizing that immediate reporting to the police is crucial and should not wait for 24 hours. Since June 1, 2011, all public security agencies have been working tirelessly to implement a rapid search mechanism for missing children, ensuring that every report triggers an immediate response. They are now exploring ways to use advanced technology to engage the public in providing critical leads to find missing children. Every second counts, and your prompt action can make a difference. Please share this message widely to help us achieve our shared goal: a world where no child is abducted. Together, we can protect our children and bring them home safely.

formal.text: According to the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, while surface-level perceptions attribute smog to heating, the root cause lies in the irrational structure of heating and consumption patterns. Most urban and rural buildings in northern regions rely on coal for heating, with a significant amount of low-quality coal. Additionally, the use of individual small boilers in city compounds and rural homes leads to higher emissions of pollutants. The primary cause of smog in Beijing is attributed to vehicle emissions rather than heating.

formal.text: Kenya's white rhinoceros Sudan, aged 42, is the last male northern white rhinoceros on Earth. To prevent poaching, armed guards are providing 24-hour protection. Given that the average lifespan of northern white rhinoceroses is around 50 years, Sudan is nearing the end of his life. Conservationists are exploring methods such as artificial insemination to ensure the species' survival.

emotional.text: Kenyans mourn the loss of Sudan, the last male northern white rhinoceros on Earth, at the age of 42. Despite the tireless efforts of armed guards who have been providing 24-hour protection to safeguard him from poachers, time is running out for this magnificent creature. With an average lifespan of about 50 years, Sudan is now in his twilight years. Conservationists are desperately working on innovative methods like artificial insemination to give the species one last chance at survival.

neutral.text: Sudan, a 42-year-old white rhinoceros in Kenya, is the last known male northern white rhinoceros. To protect him from poachers, armed guards provide 24-hour security. formal.text: Over the past decade, there has been a notable increase in glioma patients. Gliomas are the most common type of brain tumor, with high mortality and disability rates. Their prevalence is associated with excessive use of electronic devices, including keeping phones close to the body, frequent phone calls, and placing phones next to the pillow during sleep, which can lead to cumulative radiation exposure and fatigue of the body's repair mechanisms. Children, due to their thinner scalp and skull, are more sensitive to radiation. (From Urban Express Daily)

emotional.text: 近年来，胶质瘤患者的数量显著增加，这引起了广泛关注。胶质瘤是常见的脑部肿瘤，具有极高的致命性和致残性。这种疾病的发生与过度使用电子设备密切相关，如将手机紧贴身体、长时间通话以及将手机放在枕头旁边睡觉等行为，都会导致人体受到辐射累积，从而加重身体的自我修复负担。特别是对于儿童来说，他们的头皮和头骨较薄，对辐射更为敏感。为了您和家人的健康，请尽量避免这些行为。 (来自都市快报)

formal.text: In China, ordinary citizens contribute 28% of their salaries towards pension funds, whereas public servants contribute only 3%. However, after retirement, public servants receive pensions that are three times higher than those of ordinary workers, effectively being funded by ordinary workers and taxpayers. Professor Bai Zhengen from Tsinghua University notes that China's social security contributions are among the highest globally, which can be seen as a form of wealth redistribution from the poor to the rich for those whose salaries are lower than those of public servants. Please share this information to raise awareness.

emotional.text: 在中国，普通工人的养老金缴费占工资的28%，而公务员只需缴纳3%。然而，退休后的公务员领取的养老金是普通工人的三倍，实际上这些高额的退休金是由普通工人和纳税人支付的。清华大学的白重恩教授指出，中国的社保缴费在全球范围内是最高的，这实际上是一种从低收入者向高收入者的财富转移。请分享此信息，让更多人了解这一不公平现象。

formal.text: On March 13, 1988, a forest fire occurred in Shichuan County, Sichuan Province. Students from Shichuan Middle School were organized to fight the fire. Due to the intensity of the fire, the county transported the students down the mountain by vehicle. Three students, including Zhou Wei, refused to leave despite this. As the fire spread, Zhou Wei and Wang Hai managed to escape, but another student, who was severely nearsighted, perished in the flames out of fear. The county's publicity minister, who was a former subordinate of the deceased student's father, reported the incident to the central government, leading to the widespread dissemination of the story of Lai Ning.

formal.text: A mother who lost her only son in the old mountain front line 20 years ago finally had the opportunity to visit her son's grave. Why did she wait 20 years to see her son's tomb? It was because she could not afford the travel expenses to the martyrs' cemetery in Yunnan. A comrade-in-arms of her son found the family and saw that their home contained only a broken pot, a dirt bed, and a pile of cotton quilts. The elderly woman relied on the 28 yuan provided by local civil affairs every month to sustain herself.

formal.text: 如何鉴别地沟油：在烹饪过程中加入去皮的大蒜瓣（蒜子），因为蒜子对黄曲霉素最为敏感。若蒜子变为红色，则表明油中含有大量黄曲霉素，可能是地沟油。将油冷藏两小时后，如发现有类似白色泡沫的现象，也可能是地沟油。建议将此信息分享给身边的朋友。

formal.text: 76,391 cases of chlorinated Coca-Cola entered the market. It was later discovered that Chinese scientist Wu Zhonghua had researched the principles of turbine engines in the 1950s and published a paper on the three-dimensional flow equations for turbine machinery, which the British used as a basis for their engine designs. At the time, Wu Zhonghua was working at a pig farm in Hubei's 'Five Seven Cadre School'. This event highlights the complexities of historical recognition and technological development.

formal.text: 根据《水知道答案》一书，日本科学家江本胜将一杯水分别置于巴赫、莫扎特和贝多芬的音乐以及重金属摇滚音乐中各20分钟后，使用摄像设备记录了水分子结构的变化。结果显示，前者形成的水分子结构呈现出钻石般的美丽形态，而后者则类似癌细胞结构。人体内含有大量水分，其中身体总水量占比约为70%，而大脑中的水分比例高达90%。

emotional.text: 在《水知道答案》这本书中，日本科学家江本胜通过实验揭示了一个令人惊叹的事实：当一杯水被放置在巴赫、莫扎特和贝多芬的优美音乐中时，其分子结构竟然如同璀璨的钻石般美丽；然而，当同样的水被暴露在重金属摇滚音乐中时，其分子结构却变得异常混乱，甚至接近癌细胞的形态。这一发现不禁让人深思，因为人体内有大约70%的水分，而大脑中的水分比例更是高达90%！

formal.text: The Execution of Joseph Harris: A $3.5 Million Settlement. Joseph Harris, a 54-year-old death row inmate scheduled for execution on November 27, 2012, at 2 PM, died suddenly from a brain hemorrhage before his scheduled time. His last meal included a substantial amount of food and wine. The family has filed a lawsuit against the prison, alleging that despite known hypertension, he was allowed to consume alcohol, which led to his premature death. The lawsuit was successful, resulting in a settlement of $3.5 million.

formal.text: During the negotiations at Panmunjom, Peng Dehuai had requested that forces hold off American troops for two weeks at the Iron Line, but they managed to do so for only two days. The 63rd Army, which initially numbered over 30,000 personnel, was reduced to just 1,400 after the battle. The Chinese Volunteer Army defended Ungilgung, where American forces feigned a diversionary attack to concentrate their superior artillery and achieve significant enemy casualties. Ultimately, American casualties amounted to more than 400, while the United States counted over 37,000 fallen Chinese Volunteer Army soldiers. This led to public outrage in the United States against the commanding officers, which indirectly contributed to the initiation of peace talks.

formal.text: 程银宝，生于1929年，曾为国民政府时期的天门县长之女。19岁时加入国军参与抗日战争，曾在枪林弹雨中与日军作战，不幸腹部受伤，导致终身不孕。1949年后，由于其抗日经历，她多次遭受批斗和迫害，险些丧命。晚年居住在一间仅数平方米的窝棚内，生活条件极为艰苦，没有水电供应，也未获得任何社会保障。程银宝表示自己即将离世，只希望能有一件新衣服，但被告知需前往国民党领取。此消息引发广泛关注。

formal.text: 对比深圳与香港的电价，香港的电价为每度0.2元港币，而上市公司中国电力在2011年的盈利为131.88亿港元。相比之下，深圳的电价为每度0.68元人民币，当地电厂和电网普遍表示亏损。此外，香港的人均年收入约为20万元人民币，而深圳的人均年收入约为5万元人民币。对于持续声称亏损的企业和个人，是否应建立一份‘最不道德’的档案以示警示？

formal.text: The origin of the weekend system in China can be traced back to around 1994 during the most challenging phase of the Sino-US accession negotiations to the World Trade Organization (WTO). The United States suddenly proposed that, given the global adoption of a two-day weekend, China should also implement a two-day weekend for its citizens as one of the conditions for joining the WTO. As a result, starting from May 1, 1995, China began to adopt the weekend work system.

formal.text: In Illinois, United States, a minuscule cat named Pibbles has been identified. At two years old and weighing only 3 pounds, equivalent to a bag of candy, Pibbles holds the title of the world's smallest cat, as recognized by Guinness World Records. Despite reaching the normal developmental age for cats, Pibbles' diminutive size remains unusual. Experts suggest that Pibbles' small stature may be due to genetic abnormalities.

emotional.text: 在美国伊利诺斯州，人们发现了一只超萌的小猫咪，它叫皮堡斯。这只可爱的小猫已经两岁了，体重仅有3磅，差不多是一袋糖果的重量。皮堡斯是世界上最小的猫，已被吉尼斯世界纪录收录。尽管它已经达到了普通猫咪的正常发育年龄，但它的体型依然异常娇小，实在令人惊叹。专家推测，皮堡斯体型如此之小可能是因为基因缺陷。

neutral.text: In Illinois, a cat named Pibbles was found. At two years old and weighing 3 pounds, which is about the weight of a bag of candy, Pibbles is considered the world's smallest cat and is listed in the Guinness World Records. Although Pibbles has reached the normal development age for cats, its small size is rare. Experts believe that Pibbles' small size might be due to genetic defects.
